title: warpcorrect
description:
Replaces voxels in a deformation field that point to a specific out of bounds location with nan,nan,nan.

This can be used in conjunction with the warpinit command to compute a MRtrix compatible deformation field from non-linear transformations generated by any other registration package.

References:

marker.description: single value or a comma separated list of values that define out of bounds voxels in the input warp image. Default: (0,0,0).
marker.title: marker

tolerance.description: numerical precision used for L2 matrix norm comparison. Default: 9.99999975e-06.
tolerance.title: tolerance
